forum.quote: This BAA shall be governed by the laws of the State of Texas and applicable federal law, and venue shall lie as provided in the Master Services Agreement.

liability.quote: The obligations of Business Associate under this Article 8 are not subject to any limitation or exclusion of liability, and shall apply notwithstanding any limitation of liability in the Master Services Agreement.

insurance.quote: Business Associate shall maintain, throughout the term of this BAA and for three (3) years thereafter, cyber liability and network security and privacy insurance with limits of not less than Five Million U.S. Dollars ($5,000,000) per claim and in the aggregate, covering notification costs, regulatory defense and penalties, and third-party claims arising from Privacy Events, and shall name Covered Entity as an additional insured.

annexes.name: Exhibit B
annexes.quote: Business Associate shall comply with the Client Information Security Requirements set forth in Exhibit B to the Master Services Agreement, including encryption of PHI at rest and in transit, multi-factor authentication, and logging and monitoring of all access to PHI.

Parts 160, 162 and 164, each as amended.

restrictionsOnAtliq.description: Business Associate shall not, and shall ensure that no Subcontractor shall, access, view, create, receive, maintain, transmit, store or process PHI from or at any location outside the United States, whether directly or by remote access.
